title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Existing canonical source records remain in the master source register; corpus-specific records remain in their evidence-preserving source bundles; standalone bibliographic discoveries are recorded separately. Reader-facing web-discovery leads are maintained as a separate discovery layer and are not added to the audited source-identity total until deterministic deduplication/canonicalization is complete.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count volume slots with a verified external locator that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

source_registers.id_policy: new standalone discoveries receive immutable SRC-MMSC identifiers after duplicate checking

source_registers.counting_rule: Discovery leads are searchable but excluded from the audited source-identity total until canonical deduplication confirms whether a lead is a new source, alternate locator, catalogue wrapper, or duplicate. WEB-MUN-0043, WEB-MUN-0045, WEB-MUN-0057, WEB-MUN-0059, WEB-MUN-0078, WEB-MUN-0079, WEB-MUN-0083, WEB-MUN-0084 and WEB-MUN-0087 have been canonicalized as SRC-MMSC-000007, SRC-MMSC-000009, SRC-MMSC-000004, SRC-MMSC-000005, SRC-MMSC-000002, SRC-MMSC-000003, SRC-MMSC-000010, SRC-MMSC-000006 and SRC-MMSC-000008 respectively and are counted once through the standalone register, never double-counted here.

metrics.note: Audited source-identity count is repository-derived: 14 preserved canonical master-source records + 12 verified external Mundarica volume locators (II-XIII) + 10 standalone MMSC identities = 36. Eighty-seven reader-facing web-discovery leads are tracked separately; nine have been deterministically canonicalized and are counted once through the standalone source register. Seventy-eight web-discovery leads remain outside the audited identity total. The primary MMSC search log is normalized through MMSC-SEARCH-000025; MMSC-SEARCH-000026 remains preserved in its supplemental run file pending append-only consolidation. These metrics are not a claim that all Munda/Mundari sources have been discovered. Public, catalogue, index, dataset or media availability is never interpreted as unrestricted reuse permission.
